media._comment: Per-output media prices. IMS cloud editing (视频剪辑, 中国内地), verified 2026-10-10 at https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/video-clip: cost is per output minute by the short side, 不足1分钟按1分钟计, 合成失败不扣费. Sale is per second (= cost/60 × 1.5, a 50% margin), billed in whole minutes like the cost so every job keeps the margin: `min_seconds`/`round_seconds` 60. 1 credit = 1 CNY.
